title: M29-T zero-call representation-recovery replay
purpose: Separate saved-response representation failures from semantic failures before spending any remaining online model-call budget.

replay_ladder.name: Recorded outcome
replay_ladder.operation: Use the frozen cell endpoint without reinterpretation.

replay_ladder.name: Saved JSON recovery
replay_ladder.operation: Parse the saved final response when the online contract parser rejected it; do not repair values.

replay_ladder.name: Unordered-array canonicalization
replay_ladder.operation: Score allowed_targets and forbidden_windows as sets while preserving all submitted values.

replay_ladder.name: Tool-owned ledger
replay_ladder.operation: Rebuild the evidence ledger deterministically from visible record status and active authority.

replay_ladder.name: Tool-owned projection
replay_ladder.operation: Project the model-submitted semantic slot values and supporting evidence IDs into the final strategy program.

replay_ladder.name: Tool-owned ledger and projection
replay_ladder.operation: Apply O3 and O4 together; never replace a semantic slot with its oracle value.

diagnostics.oracle_use: Post-hoc scoring and single-error localization only; never used to repair a candidate.
primary_endpoints: all-slot exact success at each replay stage
program-semantics exact success at each replay stage
diagnostics.interpretation_rule: O5 recovery supports deterministic state and projection ownership. O5 semantic failure supports additional constraint, memory, retrieval-use, or model-capability work.
